NinjaTrader Guide

Funding Your NinjaTrader Cash Account

This is step one of getting your cash account trading: putting money into your live NinjaTrader account. There are three transfer methods available. We recommend wire for anyone moving a meaningful amount, since both ACH and debit card options are capped at a maximum of $5,000 per single move and wire is not.

If you wish to see the walkthrough video, you can watch it here. Otherwise, the steps below have you covered. Your progress is saved on this device.

0 of 4 steps complete

Tick each step as you go.

  1. 1

    Open your NinjaTrader account and find the funding banner

    0:00 to 0:20

    Once you have signed your agreements and your live NinjaTrader account is created, the dashboard shows a Fund your account banner and a Subscribe to market data banner. Funding comes first, since nothing else works until there is cash in the account.

    1. Log in to your NinjaTrader account.
    2. Confirm you see the orange Fund your account banner near the top of the dashboard.
  2. 2

    Click Fund Account

    0:20 to 1:20

    This takes you from the dashboard into the account settings, where every live and simulation account you have is listed with its own Fund Account button.

    1. Click the orange Fund Account button.
    2. On the Accounts page, find your live account (not the SIM/demo account) and click its Fund Account button.
  3. 3

    Choose Wire as your transfer method

    1:20 to 1:45

    NinjaTrader offers three ways to move money in: ACH, Debit Card, and Wire. ACH and Debit Card transactions are each capped at a maximum of $5,000 per move, so if you are funding with more than that, or you would rather not split it into multiple transactions, use Wire instead.

    1. On the Transfer screen, review the three options: ACH (1 to 3 business days, requires a U.S. bank account), Debit Card (1 business day, capped at $5,000 per transaction), and Wire (1 business day, name on the bank account must match the trading account, bank fees apply).
    2. Select Wire and follow the prompts from your bank to send the funds.
    3. If you are only moving a small amount and prefer speed, ACH or Debit Card still work, just remember each move tops out at $5,000.

    Recommended: use Wire. ACH and Debit Card transactions both cap at $5,000 per move, so larger deposits need multiple transactions on those methods, or a single wire.

  4. 4

    Confirm the deposit and wait for it to post

    1:45 to end

    Once the transfer is submitted, NinjaTrader takes about one business day to process it into your account balance. There is nothing else to do until the funds land.

    1. Enter the deposit amount and confirm the transfer.
    2. Wait for the deposit to post to your live account balance, typically the next business day.
    3. Once funded, move on to subscribing to market data and, if applicable, requesting sub-accounts.
    We recommend funding at least $10,000 per algorithm you plan to run. Use the cash account Algo Distribution Calculator afterward to plan how to split funds across the main account and any sub-accounts.

  5. Your account is funded

    Next, subscribe to the correct market data package for the instruments your algorithms trade, then decide whether you need sub-accounts based on your total funded capital.
